definition: Euphoric means in a sustained state of intense elation and well-being, often almost dreamlike.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word euphoric. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know euphoric should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: For a week after her first book was accepted, Dana walked around euphoric, grinning at strangers on the bus.
Content is quiet satisfaction; euphoric is a soaring, intense high of well-being that colors everything around it.
Rapturous pushes past even euphoric — joy so consuming that a person seems swept entirely away by it.

Blissful means full of serene, complete happiness -- calm, untroubled, wanting nothing more. Euphoric is also a lasting state, but it is a high: intense, soaring elation that colors everything around it. A blissful afternoon is peaceful and still; a euphoric week runs high on everything at once. Bliss rests; euphoria soars.

Exhilarated means thrillingly energized -- heart pounding, senses sharpened, the jolt you get from a fast ski run or a cold plunge. Euphoric is a sustained, dreamlike glow of well-being that floats on for days. Exhilaration spikes with the moment that causes it and fades; euphoria lingers long after any single cause.

Back on Earth after six months on the space station, Commander Reyes kept catching herself smiling at nothing.
Gravity felt like a gift, grocery stores seemed miraculous, and even a traffic jam delighted her.
The flight surgeon told her that returning crews often spend their first weeks euphoric — riding a long, dreamy high that no single moment can explain.
Reyes's weeks-long, free-floating glow — attached to everything and nothing in particular — is the sustained elevated state that euphoric names.

Milo expected the feeling to wear off by Monday.
His robotics team had taken the national title on Saturday night, and the drive home had been all noise and singing.
But the week that followed surprised him more than the win.
He moved through it euphoric: homework felt light, the cafeteria's gray trays looked almost festive, and he caught himself grinning at nothing in the hallway.
